user.title: Sign in to Atomberg
user.description: Use your Atomberg Home email and password. Control uses the app's cloud connection only. This version supports fans with firmware newer than 1.0.24. Social sign-in and MFA challenges are not supported. Passwords are used only during sign-in; session tokens are saved.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed. Check your credentials and complete verification in the Atomberg app.
error.no_devices: No supported Wi-Fi fans were found in this account.

abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the account already configured for this integration.
